title: brew upgrade devbin proven at the next release on rhad and kovacs (ST0009's WP-05, carried)
body:
ST0009's last step, carried here on hv's ruling of 2026-10-17 so the thread can close before the next release: once the next devbin batch release (directive 13) is cut and its formula is in the tap matthewsinclair/homebrew-devbin, `brew upgrade devbin` on rhad and on kovacs moves to the new tag; then in a fixture vendored from the brew install, a bare `bin/devbin upgrade` takes the new runtime through HOMEBREW_PREFIX's opt/devbin, `bin/devbin doctor` passes and reads the new version, and nothing names the removed keg.

Done when: the output from both machines is recorded in this issue's Resolution. This issue cuts no release; it is read at the next one.

## Resolution

Proven at 0.1.13 on both machines, on 2026-10-24.

**rhad**, by dc under vc's decision 55, on hv's go, in the bats window intent-vc booked (START 05:30:17Z, END 05:31:14Z):

- `brew upgrade devbin` moved rhad from 0.1.12 to 0.1.13.
  - The tap's clone first fast-forwarded to `853f641 devbin 0.1.13`.
  - It ran with `HOMEBREW_NO_AUTO_UPDATE=1 HOMEBREW_NO_AUTOREMOVE=1`, and brew's cleanup removed `Cellar/devbin/0.1.12`.
  - `devbin --version` reads `devbin 0.1.13 (6fa7b3c06a0c...)`, the release commit.
- The fixture was vendored from the 0.1.12 keg on 2026-10-23 and left untouched until this run.
  - A bare `bin/devbin upgrade` read `Upgrading from /opt/homebrew/opt/devbin/libexec (devbin 0.1.13)` and updated the runtime, rc 0. It did not report "Already up to date".
  - `bin/devbin doctor` passed (0 failed). It read `runtime: devbin 0.1.13` and `source: level`, with the install named by HOMEBREW_PREFIX's `opt/devbin`.
  - Nothing in the fixture, in the upgrade's or doctor's output, or in `shell-init` from either side names `Cellar/devbin/0.1.12`.
  - The fixture's runtime is byte-identical to the keg's.
- Records are in dc's scratch (`0201/rhad-0.1.12/` and `0201/rhad-0.1.13/`, with `HANDOVER.md`).

**kovacs**, by kovacs-sysadm running vc's order K013B (07:07:45Z to 07:08:17Z, status 0):

- The order first vendored a fixture from the 0.1.11 keg. kovacs had stayed on 0.1.11 since 2026-10-17.
  - The fixture's upgrade and doctor read level at 0.1.11, through `/home/linuxbrew/.linuxbrew/opt/devbin/libexec`.
- `brew upgrade devbin` (`HOMEBREW_NO_AUTO_UPDATE=1 HOMEBREW_NO_AUTOREMOVE=1`) moved kovacs from 0.1.11 to 0.1.13.
  - brew's cleanup removed `Cellar/devbin/0.1.11`.
  - `devbin --version` reads `devbin 0.1.13 (6fa7b3c06a0ce5cfedad4833871cd05036bd94dc)`.
- In the fixture, a bare `bin/devbin upgrade` read `Upgrading from /home/linuxbrew/.linuxbrew/opt/devbin/libexec (devbin 0.1.13)`.
  - It reported `0 added, 18 updated, 56 unchanged, 0 removed, 0 skipped`, rc 0, and not "Already up to date".
  - `bin/devbin doctor` passed, reading `devbin_version: 0.1.13` with the install named by HOMEBREW_PREFIX's `opt/devbin`.
  - A scan of the fixture and of the upgrade, doctor and shell-init outputs for `Cellar/devbin/0.1.11` found none (grep rc 1).
  - The fixture's runtime is byte-identical to the keg's (`diff -r` and `cmp`, rc 0).
- The first order, K013, died at startup and changed nothing. Its env scrub unset HOMEBREW_PREFIX, and Homebrew 7's `brew shellenv` prints nothing while its bin is on PATH. K013B takes the prefix from `brew --prefix`, and an EXIT trap now writes a status on any early death. That was a defect of the order, not of devbin.
- Records: kovacs `~/work/devbin-vc/` (`k013b.log`, `k013b.rc`, the fixture `k013b-fx`, and K013's log), with a copy of the log in vc's scratch (`kovacs/k013b.log.copy`).

Both machines now run devbin 0.1.13 from brew.
